thread:
Marissa Cole: Quick alignment thread on MVP views for the internal unit economics dashboard. Want to lock: default filters, top charts, exports, and what’s explicitly V2. If we can converge today I’ll update the MVP scope doc + ping Eng.

Alicia Perez: :eyes: following. For UX I need to know which slices are “first class” vs behind an “advanced filters” disclosure.

Talia Benson: +1. Also need an explicit “out of scope” list for launch comms so we don’t get surprise asks during rollout.

Nikhil Sharma: From Hosted API POV: MVP should answer “are we getting more expensive?” and “which model/region is driving it?” without 12 clicks.

Aditya Rao: And for Optimize: we need enough segmentation to connect levers (cache / quant profile) to $/1M output tokens, but I’m fine deferring the full driver attribution panel.

Marissa Cole: Proposal for MVP landing (default view):
- Metric: blended $/1M output tokens
- Time range default: last 14 days (toggle 7/30/custom)
- Filters default: All models, All regions, All tiers
- Grain: daily
Top charts:
1) Trend line: blended $/1M output tokens (daily) + 7d rolling
2) Stacked bars: output tokens by model family (to show mix shift context)
3) Table: cost by model x region (top 10 by tokens, sortable by blended cost)
4) KPI tiles: cache hit rate + “estimated cache savings” (if ready)
Exports: CSV download for any table + “copy link with filters”

Thoughts?

Rishi Malhotra: FP&A preference: default time range = last 30 days. 14 can be noisy and invites weekly whiplash. Also please ensure we can export the *daily series* as CSV for tie-outs.

Felix Schneider: From backend side: 30d is fine. For MVP we can do 7/30/custom. Daily series export is straightforward.

Chloe Martin: +1 on copy link w/ filters. Also we should cap “model x region” table to prevent huge queries. Top N by tokens is good.

Alicia Perez: For the layout, I’d vote:
- KPI row (current period avg, WoW change, cache hit rate)
- Trend chart
- “Breakdowns” section with tabs (by model / by region / by tier)
- Then a details table
We can avoid the stacked bars if it’s redundant with breakdown tabs.

Nikhil Sharma: Agree. For Hosted, the core drilldowns are by model and region. Tier is important but secondary for MVP.

Marissa Cole: Ok, maybe revise top charts to be more “core + breakdown tabs”:
- KPI tiles: blended cost (current 7d avg), blended cost (current 30d avg), WoW delta, output tokens
- Trend: daily blended cost
- Breakdown tabs: by model, by region, by tier (each = bar chart + table)
- Optional: cache metrics panel (hit rate + savings) behind “Advanced”

Aditya Rao: I’d push to NOT hide cache entirely. It’s a major driver and will come up immediately. Could be a small “secondary KPI” tile even if we don’t have perfect savings attribution yet.

Rishi Malhotra: Cache hit rate as a KPI is fine. Savings estimate should be clearly labeled as estimate / methodology link.

Alicia Perez: Works. We can include cache hit rate in KPI row and put savings estimate in a tooltip (“i”) with a link to definition.

Chloe Martin: One more: default should be “All tiers” but we need a quick toggle for self_serve vs dedicated vs private. I see people asking that constantly.

Marissa Cole: Yup. For MVP filter bar: Time range + Model + Region + Tier. Tier should be a single select by default? or multi?

Nikhil Sharma: Multi-select please. A common question is “self_serve vs dedicated” side-by-side, so let users select both and compare.

Felix Schneider: Compare view adds complexity. But multi-select filter that just aggregates is easy. Side-by-side comparison (two cohorts) is more work.

Talia Benson: Let’s be explicit: MVP supports multi-select filters but not cohort comparison (no “A vs B” mode).

Marissa Cole: Good call. MVP = filter + aggregate. V2 = cohort compare.

Alicia Perez: UX note: multi-select tier will be fine but we should avoid multi-select on model *and* region at the same time if it nukes perf. Maybe “advanced filters” gating for high-cardinality combos.

Chloe Martin: +1. Also we probably need a “Top 5 models” quick selector for perf.

Felix Schneider: We can enforce guardrails: if model filter = All, then region breakdown shows top regions; if model has >5 selected, we show a warning + disable region breakdown table. I’ll sync w/ Thomas on limits.

Marissa Cole: Export needs: MVP should cover FP&A / support workflows:
- Export table as CSV
- Export time series as CSV
- Copy shareable link (internal)
Not doing PDF, not doing scheduled emails in MVP.

Rishi Malhotra: :thumbsup: CSV is sufficient. Please include columns for: date, model_family/model_variant (where applicable), region, tier, blended_cost_per_1m_output_tokens, output_tokens, and (if present) cache_hit_rate.

Aditya Rao: Quant profile slicing: do we include in MVP? If not, at least ensure the dataset has the tag so we can join later.

Marissa Cole: Product POV: quant profile as a *filter dimension* feels V2 (it’s niche + adds complexity). But I’m fine adding a small “runtime config” section in advanced later.

Chloe Martin: Agree quant profile filter V2. MVP should keep it to model/region/tier.

Nikhil Sharma: Another V2 item: “route/config” (batching policy, cache policy) slices. Useful but not needed for initial adoption.

Alicia Perez: Also V2: the “Explain cost delta” panel (waterfall / driver attribution). For MVP we can link out to a doc explaining common drivers.

Talia Benson: Let’s write the explicit deferrals:
- Driver attribution / explain panel
- Cohort compare (A vs B)
- Route/config (batching/caching policy) filter
- Quantization profile filter
- Account-level/customer drilldowns
- Scheduled exports
- Forecasting
Anything else?

Rishi Malhotra: Add: “discounts/credits impact view” should be restricted and can be deferred (or delivered behind finance-only gating later). Don’t put it in MVP if access control isn’t ready.

Marissa Cole: Yep. MVP will show blended cost pre-discount? Actually the canonical metric includes credits/discount policy? We’re still finalizing w/ Finance. For MVP UI we’ll show the canonical metric only and avoid any “discount impact” breakdown.

Nikhil Sharma: One more MVP ask: a small “Data freshness” indicator. If last partition is delayed, I don’t want people screenshotting incomplete numbers.

Alicia Perez: I can add a “Last updated” timestamp + warning banner state (e.g., “Data delayed, last complete day: YYYY-MM-DD”).

Felix Schneider: That’s doable, we’ll expose `last_complete_partition` from the API.

Marissa Cole: Cool. Summary for MVP (tentative):
- Default: last 30 days, all model/region/tier
- KPI tiles: blended $/1M output tokens (30d avg), WoW delta, output tokens, cache hit rate
- Trend chart (daily)
- Breakdown tabs: by model, by region, by tier (bar + table), with guardrails
- Exports: CSV (tables + time series) + copy link
- Freshness indicator
Deferrals: explain panel, cohort compare, route/config + quant profile filters, account-level drilldowns, scheduled reports, discount-impact views.

If no objections by EOD I’ll update the MVP scope doc and tag Eng.

Talia Benson: :thumbsup: Works for me.

Aditya Rao: :thumbsup: +1. As long as we don’t forget quant profile is a strong V2 priority.

Rishi Malhotra: :thumbsup: aligned.

Chloe Martin: +1. Please tag me when the scope doc is updated so I can line up backend endpoints accordingly.

Alicia Perez: Great. I’ll proceed with wireframes based on this (KPI row + trend + breakdown tabs + details table + freshness banner).

Marissa Cole: Done. I’ll post the updated doc link here once I push it.
